tour.prompt.title: New here?
tour.prompt.text: Take a 20-second tour of what this converter can do.
tour.step1.title: Converting from
tour.step1.text: This is where you start. Click it to pick any country, city or time zone, like Cairo or PST.
tour.step2.title: The time
tour.step2.text: Drag the slider, or click the big time to type an exact time. It follows the current time until you change it.
tour.step3.title: The date
tour.step3.text: Pick a date to convert for that day. Daylight saving changes are applied for the date you choose.
tour.step4.title: Converting to
tour.step4.text: Each card shows the same moment somewhere else. Click a card for a plain explanation. On cities and countries, the small arrow opens that place's page.
tour.step5.title: Add a place or time zone
tour.step5.text: Compare as many places and time zones as you like, including PST, EST and GMT.

gen.pair.desc.fixed: Convert {A} time to {B} time. {ab1} all year. Free converter with a conversion table.
gen.pair.desc.varies: Convert {A} time to {B} time. {ab1} in January and {dur2} {dir2} in July. Free converter with a conversion table.

gen.pair.overlap.differs: If both sides work 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM: in January, {o1}. In July, {o2}.
